# iamharinda.com

> Photo editing, custom web development, and fashion designing — three
> services run by one person, Harinda Fernando, from Sri Lanka, for clients
> in the United States, Canada and Europe.

## Who

iamharinda is a one-person studio run by Harinda Fernando. Photo editing is
done by hand on a colour-calibrated, Calman-verified display and judged by
eye — no AI look, no batch preset, no auto-retouch. The Fiverr profile is
rated 4.9 over 183 reviews with 300+ completed orders.

## Photo editing

Colour correction, retouching, and bulk photo editing for photographers,
including wedding, portrait, headshot, family, event, real estate, product
and drone work — in Adobe Lightroom, Lightroom Classic and Photoshop.

What's included: white balance and colour correction, exposure/contrast/tonal
adjustments, clean natural colour grading, noise reduction and sharpening,
lens corrections and cropping, and photo culling for large galleries.

Pricing (US dollars):
- General bulk editing — 50 photos $10, 100 photos $20, 200 photos $40, over
  200 custom bulk pricing on request (fiverr.com or /pricing/)
- Wedding, portrait and headshot packages — Basic $10 (50 images, 2-day
  delivery), Standard $40 (200 images, 3-day), Premium $100 (500 images,
  4-day) — all with unlimited revisions (/photo-editing/)

A free sample edit (two or three photos) is available before ordering the
general bulk service. For wedding/portrait packages, message before ordering
to confirm the right package and timeline.

## Custom web development

Sites and web apps coded from scratch — no WordPress, no page builders, no
plugin dependencies. The code is handed over to the client.

Pricing (US dollars): single-page/landing site $750, marketing site up to 8
pages $1,500, business site with CMS $2,500, web application/custom tooling
$4,000, ongoing maintenance $150/month, work outside agreed scope $40/hour.
Every project starts with a free scope call. (/web-development/)

## Fashion designing

Print-ready polo and golf shirt pattern design and mockups, built in Adobe
Illustrator and Photoshop — print patterns, textile design, and front/back
garment artwork.

Pricing (US dollars): Basic $10 (1 design, 1-day delivery), Standard $25 (3
designs, 2-day), Premium $40 (5 designs, 2-day) — all with unlimited
revisions. (/fashion-designing/)

## Blog

In-depth, practical articles for photographers and business owners covering
photo editing workflow and Lightroom technique, pricing and outsourcing
decisions, hiring a web developer, and ordering pattern/apparel design —
written for people with no technical background in the topic. (/blog/)

## Payment methods

PayPal invoice (credit/debit card, Venmo, Apple Pay, Google Pay), PayPal
transfer, Payoneer, Remitly, TapSend, or bank deposit. Photo work is invoiced
after delivery and approval, with no deposit. Web and fashion design projects
are staged, with the split set out on each service page.

## How to order

1. Message on WhatsApp or book through Fiverr to discuss the project first.
2. Send the files (RAW photos, a logo/reference for fashion design, or a
   scope for a web project).
3. Review proofs or a draft, then request revisions until it's right.
4. Pay per each service's terms above.

## Areas served

United States, Canada, and Europe. All work is delivered online.
